route: Falset. Costa Daurada - Roquetes. Terres de l'Ebre

intermediate.name: Puerto de Paüls
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Puerto de Paüls (148.4 km)

story: The early breakaway was kept on a short leash and caught with 99 km remaining as the peloton increased the pace. Ethan Hayter attacked for sprint points, while Andreas Kron tried his luck later. UAE Team Emirates controlled the climb, before Matthew Brennan won the sprint after excellent Visma-Lease a Bike teamwork.
